title: feat(desktop): Prepare screen — where is your video going? (NIW2-578)
body:
Linear: [NIW2-578](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-578/prepare-screen-where-is-it-going-replaces-the-export-sheet-for-a) · Design: Claude Design [Kaipu Prepare Screen](https://claude.ai/design/p/71546ef1-baf5-42e9-8fcc-9b9b44f2c7ab?file=Kaipu+Prepare+Screen.dc.html) · Stacked on [#436](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/436) (YouTube 1440p / 4K, NIW2-564)

## Why

Until now a recording was shared through a modal export sheet with a preset list. The owner found two problems with it: the YouTube 1440p / 4K option was hidden inside that list, and "make it bigger to look better" is not intuitive. Beginners think about where a video is going, not about presets. This PR replaces the recording's Share sheet with a full-screen **Prepare** flow built around one question: *where is it going?*

The recording is the original and is never modified (ADR 0003). Prepare makes a new copy (a derived library item) in the background, through the same export pipeline as before.

## What changed

**Prepare screen, `/prepare/:assetId`** (`?to=<destination>` preselects one). It has three columns:
- **The original:** thumbnail, title, duration, picture size, file size, and "Copies are made from this file. It is never changed or replaced.". There is an amber note when the edit session holds edits that no file has yet. **Already prepared** lists the copies this recording already has, each linking to its page.
- **Where is it going?** The destinations are grouped by who compresses the video last, each with its estimated size:
  - *They re-compress it · send more*: YouTube, Reels · TikTok · Shorts, LinkedIn · Feeds.
  - *They play it as-is · keep it light*: GitHub · Jira · Linear (Light), Slack · Discord · Email (Balanced).
  - *Keep*: Archive copy (Maximum).

  A destination that already has a matching copy shows **Ready** instead of a size.
- **The copy:**
  - a size meter (the recording against the copy, on one scale) tagged "Bigger on purpose", "N% lighter", "Not lighter" or "Same as the recording";
  - a "Why bigger? / Why smaller?" paragraph;
  - the YouTube 1440p / 4K selector with each size, defaulting through `defaultYoutubePreset`;
  - Fill / Fit with the existing framing preview for vertical and square;
  - GitHub's free / paid plan chips;
  - a folded **What changes in the copy** section (picture, smoothness, sound, in words, with no bitrate or fps);
  - the button **Prepare for <destination> · ~size**.

  When a matching copy already exists, the button becomes **Open the copy you have**, with **Prepare again** next to it.
- **Prepare** starts the background export and goes back to the recording page, where the existing progress card and then the Ready card take over. If another export is running, the existing busy toast shows. An unreadable file shows the existing error toast and goes back to the recording. Screenshots and GIFs say they can't be prepared.

**Destination model** (`features/prepare/destinations.ts`, pure, unit-tested). It maps each destination to its preset(s), groups them, and `planCopy` describes one copy: size kind and estimate, size direction, GitHub free-limit fit, and the picture, smoothness and sound changes. Every number comes from `resolveExportTarget`.

**One pipeline** (`features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts`). This is the old `useShareRecording` start logic, extracted: `initialScene`, `WHOLE_RECORDING_FINGERPRINT`, preset and framing, `useVideoExport().start`.

**Recording page:**
- **Prepare for…** replaces Share as the primary button.
- Quick chips (YouTube, TikTok · Reels, GitHub) sit under the title.
- The heavy-to-send banner's action is now "Prepare a light copy →", which opens Prepare on GitHub.
- The post-recording **"Your video is ready. Where is it going?"** panel replaces the Recording saved card. It shows after **every** recording, not only heavy ones. It has the shortcuts YouTube, TikTok · Reels, GitHub · Jira, Slack · Discord and More places, plus Edit first and "Not now — keep it in the Library". It is still controlled by `showRecordingSavedCard`; only the Settings label changed, to "Ask where a new recording is going".
- The page re-lists when an export becomes ready, so the new copy appears under Exports.

**Library:** recording cards and list rows get a **Prepare for…** icon button next to Edit.

**Removed** (no consumers left): the Share sheet wiring (`share-recording.tsx`), `RecordingSavedCard`, `SHARE_LIMIT_BYTES`, and their unused i18n keys.

**i18n:** a new `prepare` namespace in `en.json` and `es.json` (neutral Spanish).

**Docs:** `backlog/prepare-screen.md` (🟢 Ready to validate), a backlog index row, and a sidebar entry. `backlog/export-presets.md` now points to it.

## Decisions I took

- **The editor keeps its export sheet.** It applies the edits and Prepare does not, so only the recording's Share moved.
- **"Under the 10 MB limit"** shows only when the estimate fits GitHub's free plan (`githubPlans().free`). `githubFit()` checks the paid 100 MB limit, so using it would make the 10 MB claim false for most recordings.
- **No "Time" row** in "What changes". We have no honest encode-time estimate yet, so the row is left out instead of guessed.
- **Generic lucide icons on platform colours**, not brand logos. lucide 1.x ships no brand marks.
- **The Ready card keeps "Ready to share"** (not "Ready to upload"), because the editor's export shares it.
- **The panel no longer auto-hides after 8 s.** The design makes it the first nudge and "Not now" is the way out. It also shows for small recordings now.
- **Library card affordance:** added as one more icon in the existing action row. It fits the card without clutter.
- Exports of a recording can be prepared too, as Share allowed before.

## Not done / out of scope

- Importing outside videos, a sidebar entry, a real before/after frame, a recording-quality floor, and uploading anywhere (all out of scope per the ticket).
- **Nothing was run in Electron or in the Playwright desktop suite.** Runtime QA is the owner's.

## Verification

`bun run verify` passes: lint, oxfmt, build, types, and all tests (kaipu-record: 310 files, 3002 tests). New tests:
- `destinations.test.ts` (14)
- `prepare-page.test.tsx` (14)
- `where-is-it-going-panel.test.tsx` (5)
- updated `library-detail-page.test.tsx`, `video-card.test.tsx`, `settings-layout.test.tsx`, `export-size.test.ts`, `window-size.test.ts`

## How to test it yourself

1. Run `bun run rebuild:native` if it is pending, then start the desktop app and record a short clip (10–20 s).
2. When recording stops, the recording page opens with **"Your video is ready. Where is it going?"** above the player. It should show the duration, picture size, size, and the YouTube, TikTok · Reels, GitHub · Jira, Slack · Discord and More places shortcuts.
3. Click **YouTube**. The Prepare screen opens with YouTube selected, "Bigger on purpose", and the "Why bigger?" paragraph.
4. Check that **1440p** is preselected (or 4K if your capture is bigger than 2560×1440). Switch to **4K** and back, and watch the size change in the selector and on the button.
5. Unfold **What changes in the copy** and check Picture (2560 × 1440, scaled up), Smoothness and Sound (studio quality).
6. Click **Prepare for YouTube · up to ~… MB**. You land back on the recording page, and the progress card shows a percentage, time left and Cancel.
7. Wait for the **Ready** card. Drag the file chip to Finder, or use Show in Finder, and confirm it is a 2560×1440 MP4.
8. Open the **Library** and check that the copy is there (titled "… (YouTube)"). Back on the recording page, it is under Exports. Open **Prepare for…** again: the copy appears under **Already prepared**, and YouTube shows **Ready** with **Open the copy you have**.
9. GitHub / light path: on the recording page, click the **GitHub** quick chip. Prepare opens on GitHub · Jira · Linear, with "N% lighter" and the free / paid GitHub chips. Its list line says "Under the 10 MB limit" only for a short clip. Prepare it, then check that the copy is smaller than the recording.
10. With a recording over 25 MB, the heavy banner's **Prepare a light copy →** opens Prepare on GitHub.
11. Pick **Reels · TikTok · Shorts**, switch **Fill / Fit**, and watch the preview change. Prepare it and check that the copy is 1080×1920.
12. Start one copy, go back to Prepare and start another: the "Already exporting …" toast shows and you stay on Prepare.
13. Open a recording from the Library (not right after recording): no panel appears, but **Prepare for…** and the quick chips are there. Library cards and rows have the Prepare icon next to Edit. Screenshots have no Prepare action.
14. In Settings → Export quality, turn off **Ask where a new recording is going**, record again, and confirm the panel no longer appears.
15. Switch the app to Spanish and look over the Prepare screen and the panel.
